{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Confirm: only two channels exist
print(f'Unique channels: {df["channel"].unique()}')

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == '999999.99'
print(f'Number of QA orders: {df[qa_mask].shape[0]}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {df[refunded_mask].shape[0]}')

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_df = df[~refunded_mask].copy()
print(f'Number of completed orders: {len(completed_df)}')

# Convert revenue from string to float
# Remove commas and cast to float
completed_df['revenue_float'] = completed_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for any negative or implausible values
print(f'Revenue range: {completed_df["revenue_float"].min()} to {completed_df["revenue_float"].max()}')

# Sum revenue by channel
channel_revenue = completed_df.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue_float'].sum()
print(f'Channel revenue: {channel_revenue.to_dict(orient="records")}')

# Determine the channel with highest revenue
max_channel = channel_revenue.loc[channel_revenue['revenue_float'].idxmax(), 'channel']
max_revenue = channel_revenue['revenue_float'].max()

# Output
print(f'Max revenue channel: {max_channel}, Revenue: {max_revenue}')"}
